item.title: Version 1.1.0
item.description:
• Add a Storage screen with safe one-click cache cleans (#35)
  • Show disk used per kind on the cleaner cards (#37)
  • Remove a kept worktree anyway, with its size and last use (#36)
  • Keep a worktree that holds locked files (#29)
  • Show the version and an update card at the bottom of the sidebar (#28)
  • Give archived Claude sessions' worktrees the usual checks (#27)
  • Show the version as MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH without the build in brackets (#26)
  • Make read-only folders writable before removing a worktree (#25)
  • Let unmerged worktrees go once a branch holds every commit (#23)
  • Make main's CI reliable (lock race with launching processes) (#22)
  • Clean Xcode DerivedData as a third kind (#21)
  • Let ignored junk and main-checkout copies through (#18)
  • Scan shows a progress bar that only moves forward (#17)
  • Confirmation sheet scrolls its list so Cancel and Clean stay on screen (#16)
  • Refuse a release that Sparkle would never offer (#15)
  • Keep a copy only of Xcode device names (#14)
  • Show the price, warn before the trial ends, confirm deactivation (#13)
  • Faster scans with round-robin worktree jobs, one history walk, and parallel probes (#11)
  • Agents can only tighten rules and protection, and every change is recorded (#10)
  • Quitting or an update waits for a clean, and Activity keeps each finished item (#12)
  • Usable at the minimum window, clearer protected and driver copy, distinct destructive color (#8)
  • Prune a worktree whose folder is missing only in a clean you start (#3)
  • Re-runnable releases, clean dry run, pinned Sparkle tools (#9)
  • MCP answers calls concurrently and routes writes by who holds the lock (#6)
  • Keep a simulator you are debugging, and match processes to devices in one pass (#7)
  • Stop license rechecks from locking paid copies (#1)
  • Read the old delete-days setting safely and show the GitHub CLI note only when gh is missing (#4)
  • Keep the copy with app data and the most recently used copy, per iOS version (#2)
  • Resume the transcript index from a saved cache and skip transcripts older than 30 days (#5)
